on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: read
  pull-requests: read
  security-events: read
tools:
  github:
    toolsets: [repos, issues, pull_requests, code_security]

safe-outputs:
  create-issue:
    max: 1
engine: gemini

# Hello World Agentic WF

## Objective
Create a workflow that instructs the GitHub Copilot coding agent to generate a new issue in the repository with the title "hello world".

## Context
The repository does not currently contain an automated mechanism for generating issues programmatically. The goal is to enable an agentic workflow that produces a new issue using a predefined title.

## Requirements
- The workflow must create exactly one issue.
- The issue title must be the literal string: `hello world`.
- The workflow should avoid creating duplicate issues if one with the same title already exists.
- The agent must use GitHub-native operations available within agentic workflows.

## Steps
- Check for an existing issue whose title exactly matches `hello world`.
- IF a matching issue exists:
  - Do not create a new issue.
  - Output a message indicating that the issue already exists.
- ELSE:
  - Create a new issue with the title `hello world`.
  - Include a minimal placeholder body such as a single sentence describing that the issue was generated by the workflow.

## Constraints
- Do not include implementation code or GitHub API calls; the agent should determine those details.
- The workflow must follow GitHub Agentic Workflows frontmatter conventions and safe-outputs requirements.
- Only pseudo-code may be used to describe logic.
